title: Preface
summary: The partial document is an Inhaltsverzeichnis (table of contents) for Elbe Werft's 2025 Jahresbericht (annual report). It covers various sections including the company overview, order backlog, shipbuilding projects, repair operations, finances, and outlook for the future.

title: Das Unternehmen
summary: The partial document covers the establishment and current operations of Elbe Werft GmbH, a shipbuilding company founded in 1919 in Lauenburg an der Elbe. It mentions that the company employs 410 workers at two locations and specializes in building inland and small sea vessels. The document also notes the company's facilities, including a machine hall, dock area, and a design department with 32 engineers, along with an apprenticeship workshop that trains in four trades.

title: Auftragsbestand 2025
summary: The partial document covers the order backlog as of December 31, 2025, including six new builds valued at 41.2 million EUR, which was 14% higher than the previous year. It also mentions that four ships were delivered in 2025, with an average build time of 11 months, one month less than the previous year.

title: Schiffbauprojekte
summary:
The partial document covers Schiffbauprojekte (shipbuilding projects) for the year 2025 and early 2026. It includes details on ship types, lengths, and delivery dates. Key points include:

- Shipbuilding projects with various types of ships such as Frachtmotorschiffe (bulk cargo ships), Schubverbände (tugs), Passagierfähren (passenger ferries), and Tankmotorschiffe (tankers).
- Length specifications for each ship.
- Delivery dates for each ship, ranging from April 2025 to October 2026.
- Baunummer 584 is noted as the first ship with a gas-powered onboard network for harbor stays, with an expected delivery in April 2026.

title: Reparaturbetrieb
summary: The partial document covers a repair business's operations in 2025, including the total number of jobs completed, median dock time, dock capacity, and a significant individual job.

title: Finanzen
summary: The partial document covers financial metrics of a shipyard for the year 2025, including the turnover, export percentage, pre-tax profit, capital ratio, and investments made. Key points include a turnover of 68.7 million EUR, an export share of 22%, a pre-tax profit of 1.9 million EUR, a capital ratio of 31%, and significant investments such as a new 60-ton crane and the expansion of the painting hall.

title: Ausblick
summary:
The partial document covers the following main points:
1. The shipyard is developing a hydrogen onboard network for inland ships in collaboration with two partners.
2. A pilot project is scheduled to run from summer 2026 on the Elbe.
3. The apprenticeship rate is 8 percent.
4. Construction of a second shipbuilding hall is planned for 2027, which will cover both Helgen year-round.
